A day for each feast

Fete de Papa Zaka - Feast of the Farmer Loa

A Day of Gratitude for Papa Zaka

Join us in a heartfelt home celebration for Papa Zaka, the benevolent farmer lwa, honouring his protection of crops and labouring families. This day is dedicated to giving thanks and sharing abundance with loved ones.

  1. Morning

    Preparing the Sacred Altar

    Begin the day by dressing your home altar with straw hats, ears of corn, and bowls of grain, symbolizing Papa Zaka's connection to the earth. Add offerings of rum and pipe tobacco to honour his presence.

  2. Late Morning

    Cooking for the Feast

    Start preparing the more time-intensive dishes for the communal meal, ensuring everything is fresh and flavourful. This is a good time to make the vibrant pikliz.

    Recipes: Pikliz · Soup Joumou · Griot de Porc

  3. Late Afternoon

    Welcoming Aperitifs

    As guests arrive, offer refreshing traditional drinks to set a festive and welcoming tone. These beverages are a delightful start to the evening's celebrations.

    Recipes: Clairin Ti Punch · Kleren Anisette (Anise-Infused Clairin) · Pumpkin-Spice Jus Giraumon

  4. Early Evening

    First Course Delights

    Gather around to enjoy the comforting and flavourful first courses, sharing stories and laughter. The warm soup and savoury accra are perfect for opening the appetite.

    Recipes: Soup Joumou · Accra de Morue with Pikliz · Mayi Moulen ak Sos Pwa (Cornmeal with Bean Sauce)

  5. Evening

    The Abundant Main Feast

    Present the bountiful main dishes, a testament to the earth's generosity and Papa Zaka's blessings. Serve with traditional sides for a truly satisfying meal.

    Recipes: Poulet Nan Sos (Haitian Chicken in Sauce) · Griot de Porc · Legim Nan Diri (Haitian Vegetable Stew with Rice) · Red Beans with Rice (Riz Collé ak Pwa Wouj) · Bannann Peze (Twice-Fried Plantains) · Pain Mayi (Haitian Corn Bread)

  6. Late Evening

    Sweet Endings and Offerings

    Conclude the feast with delightful desserts and fresh tropical fruits. Remember to place offerings of roasted corn, a grain-filled straw hat, rum, and pipe tobacco on the altar for Papa Zaka.

    Recipes: Pen Patat · Bonbons Sirop (Haitian Lime Syrup Candies) · Papa Zaka's Harvest Fruit Medley · Roasted Corn for Papa Zaka · Papa Zaka's Spiced Rum Offering

May your home be blessed with the bounty and protection of Papa Zaka throughout the year.
